metadata.title: Cliopatria v0.2.1 — European extract
metadata.dateSemantics: fromYear <= selectedYear <= toYear (inclusive); source intervals are approximate historical reconstructions, not annual measurements
metadata.geometryEdits: Spatial clip to bbox; make_valid when needed; topology-preserving simplification 0.022 then 0.035 degrees; 3 decimal precision; no manual boundary invention. Consecutive records with exactly equal simplified clipped geometry and polity membership are coalesced; original row numbers retained in sourceRecords. After coordinate rounding, 109 geometries repaired using make_valid.
metadata.citation: Bennett, J. S., Mutch, E., Tollefson, A., et al. (2025). Cliopatria – A geospatial database of world-wide political entities from 3400BCE to 2024CE. Scientific Data 12, 247.
